name: video-transcript-reader
description: Read and summarize public YouTube video transcripts with transcript-quality checks and a fast /read workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Read YouTube videos without watching the full video
interface.longDescription: Retrieve a public YouTube transcript, check transcript completeness and duplication, then turn the video into a concise source-grounded summary with key ideas, evidence, timestamps, verification flags, and practical takeaways.
defaultPrompt: Summarize this YouTube video so I do not have to watch the full video
Extract the key ideas and important claims from this YouTube video
Fact-check the material claims in this YouTube video
